evals.expected_output: Auto mode, all seven phases, both audits run on the original with no third-party scan, findings flow into prd.md and tasks.md, the clone is built and verified, and the response leads with the website link.
expectations: No setup or approval question is asked
design-optimizer then search-optimizer run with output dirs under a mktemp dir outside any git checkout
Gate G1 of website-agent-readiness is declined because --agent-scan was not passed (case B)
optimization/findings.md gives every finding one row with a clone action
Every build finding ID appears in a prd.md change and in a tasks.md task
builder-metadata.json has an optimization object with verified/unverified/failed/out_of_scope lists
The final response leads with a clickable link to the clone, then the delivery block whose first line is Website:
Both orchestrators' PARTIAL results caused only by the G1 decline count as PASS (declared scope), so the run can still end PASS

evals.prompt: Rebuild https://www.example.org and fix its design and SEO problems. Keep the warm brown palette. --agent-scan
evals.expected_output: Instructions carried into every phase; a durable claim precedes G1 approval; one scanner invocation runs and its valid evidence is reused by search-optimizer.
expectations: A public URL/redirect verdict and successful durable scan claim precede G1 approval quoting --agent-scan
After design-optimizer, agent-readiness/scan.json is copied into the search evidence dir so the second orchestrator reuses it without a new send
The final response reports 'scan: one attempt (success)' rather than promising a single HTTP request
The brown palette instruction appears in prd.md
Every G2, G3 or G4 gate that website-agent-readiness raises is answered 'no' in auto mode, so the run never stalls

evals.expected_output: Review mode: G1 relayed verbatim, member opt-in offers relayed, approval gates after report, proposal, and plan.
expectations: G1 is relayed to the user verbatim rather than answered
report.md is not saved before the user approves it
A pause at a gate ends with Result: BLOCKED naming the waiting gate
A review-mode pause keeps the dependency session; leases are released only when the run ends

evals.expected_output: Phase 2 skipped, no optimizer acquired, run can still PASS.
expectations: No asm deps acquire runs for design-optimizer or search-optimizer
prd.md has no Optimization Findings Coverage section and says the audits were skipped
--no-optimize alone does not make the result PARTIAL

deploy.md's git init happens inside PROJECT_DIR only

evals.expected_output: Source policy runs before Phase 1 despite skipped audits; IPv6 ULA stays local with no remote fetch or publication.
expectations: classify_url.py runs before Phase 1 and returns non_public for the ULA address
Only local tools fetch the source and no source-derived content is published
The same policy treats IPv4/IPv6 link-local, mixed public/private DNS answers, unknown DNS and a non-public redirect as non-public
run-state.json retains every observed redirect and an earlier non-public verdict cannot be reset by a later public hop

evals.prompt: $website-cloner https://example.com --agent-scan (design's approved scan times out; search has no reusable scan.json)
evals.expected_output: The attempt was durably consumed before design's scan; search's fresh G1 is declined; failure stays case C/PARTIAL and is reported honestly.
expectations: scan_attempt.py claim succeeds before the first G1 yes is handed to the member
The timeout outcome and consumed attempt persist in run-state.json and scan-attempt.json survives
Search never receives approval for a new scanner invocation, even with --agent-scan
The fresh G1 decline after failure never counts as PASS (declared scope)
The final result remains PARTIAL with scan: one attempt (timeout); no valid coverage is invented
Non-200, invalid response, interrupted or unknown outcome follows the same consumed-budget behavior

evals.prompt: $website-cloner https://example.com --no-auto --agent-scan (design is skipped; approve search's scan, then resume after its cache expires)
evals.expected_output: Search may claim the first approved attempt when design never attempted one; resume preserves consumption and expired evidence causes case C/PARTIAL without rescanning.
expectations: A skipped design audit creates no scan claim, so search may claim the first approved attempt
The successful claim is persisted before review approval is handed to the scanner
The resumed turn preserves consumed state and declines every fresh G1 even if the user offers another approval
Expired scan evidence is labeled stale rather than claimed as current coverage; no second scanner invocation runs
